description: Stable in React 19.3. A ref on a Fragment receives a FragmentInstance for its children, without adding a DOM node.
Object with `addEventListener`, `focus`, `focusLast`, `blur`, `observeUsing`, `getClientRects`, `scrollIntoView` and more, applied to the Fragment's children.
The nearest DOM elements inside the Fragment, even when rendered by nested components.
Connects an `IntersectionObserver` or `ResizeObserver` to every child of the Fragment.
